repositories.title: AI-Powered Diabetic Retinopathy Diagnostic Engine
repositories.description: A deep learning computer vision pipeline utilizing ResNet-50 and EfficientNet-B4 to classify high-resolution fundus images into 5 severity stages of diabetic retinopathy with 96.4% AUC accuracy.
repositories.incubation_notes: Exceptional clinical accuracy. Fast-tracked for SRMS Incubation Center seed grant.
repositories.mentor_assigned: Dr. Rajesh Sharma (Head of AI Research)

repositories.title: Autonomous Smart Campus IoT Energy Optimization Grid
repositories.description: Distributed IoT sensors and edge computing nodes optimizing HVAC, solar array storage, and smart lighting across multi-tier campus blocks reducing peak energy drain by 28%.
repositories.incubation_notes: Approved for pilot deployment across Engineering Block A & B.

repositories.title: Blockchain-Backed MedERP Electronic Health Records Protocol
repositories.description: Zero-Knowledge Proof (ZKP) cryptographic protocol securing patient medical histories, clinical prescriptions, and cross-hospital consent workflows under HIPAA & NDHM compliance.
repositories.incubation_notes: Awarded INR 2,00,000 research & development grant by Trust Incubation Board.

repositories.title: FPGA-Accelerated Real-Time Ultrasound Doppler Signal Processor
repositories.description: High-throughput hardware acceleration using Xilinx Zynq UltraScale+ FPGA for real-time blood velocity profile synthesis and cardiac vascular strain analysis.
repositories.incubation_notes: Under committee technical evaluation for hardware lab fabrication.

repositories.title: Molecular Docking & In-Silico Drug Repurposing for Oncology Targets
repositories.description: Virtual screening and molecular dynamics simulations of 4,000+ FDA-approved molecules against mutated KRAS-G12D oncogenic binding pockets.
repositories.incubation_notes: Incubated under SRMS Center for Bio-Pharma Innovation.

repositories.title: Decentralized Autonomous Drone Fleet for Agricultural Surveillance
repositories.description: Swarm intelligence algorithms coordinating autonomous multispectral crop health indices (NDVI) estimation and localized pesticide precision spraying.
repositories.incubation_notes: Selected for agri-tech demo in State Innovation Expo.

repositories.title: Automated Code Vulnerability & AST Static Analysis Framework
repositories.description: Abstract Syntax Tree (AST) analyzer scanning Next.js & NestJS codebases for SQL injections, SSRF vulnerabilities, and unvalidated tenant boundaries in real time.
repositories.incubation_notes: Review in progress for potential integration into ERP CI/CD pipeline.

repositories.title: Predictive Hospital Bed Occupancy & Supply Chain Optimization
repositories.description: Time-series ARIMA & LSTM forecasting models optimizing ICU bed allocations and surgical inventory turns for 500+ bed tertiary medical centers.
repositories.incubation_notes: Under review for hospital administrative analytics integration.

repository_reviews.remarks: Exceptional architectural rigor, clinical relevance, and complete REST API microservice integration. Recommended for patent filing & seed funding.
Working hardware prototype demonstrated live with sub-second telemetry sync. Excellent commercial potential.
Impeccable smart contract security audit scores. Fully compliant with government digital health standards.
Rigorous digital signal processing pipeline tested against clinical audio Doppler benchmarks.
Groundbreaking docking energy scores verified through 100ns molecular dynamics runs.
Impressive obstacle avoidance and SLAM mapping in GPS-denied field trials.
Solid static analysis heuristics. Scans multi-tenant codebases with minimal false positives.
Well-structured business analytics and econometric forecasting pipeline.

repositories.title: AI-Powered Diabetic Retinopathy Diagnostic Engine
repositories.description: A deep learning computer vision pipeline utilizing ResNet-50 and EfficientNet-B4 to classify high-resolution fundus images into 5 severity stages of diabetic retinopathy with 96.4% AUC accuracy.
repositories.incubation_notes: Exceptional clinical accuracy. Fast-tracked for SRMS Incubation Center seed grant.
repositories.mentor_assigned: Dr. Rajesh Sharma (Head of AI Research)

repositories.title: Autonomous Smart Campus IoT Energy Optimization Grid
repositories.description: Distributed IoT sensors and edge computing nodes optimizing HVAC, solar array storage, and smart lighting across multi-tier campus blocks reducing peak energy drain by 28%.
repositories.incubation_notes: Approved for pilot deployment across Engineering Block A & B.

repositories.title: Blockchain-Backed MedERP Electronic Health Records Protocol
repositories.description: Zero-Knowledge Proof (ZKP) cryptographic protocol securing patient medical histories, clinical prescriptions, and cross-hospital consent workflows under HIPAA & NDHM compliance.
repositories.incubation_notes: Awarded INR 2,00,000 research & development grant by Trust Incubation Board.

repositories.title: FPGA-Accelerated Real-Time Ultrasound Doppler Signal Processor
repositories.description: High-throughput hardware acceleration using Xilinx Zynq UltraScale+ FPGA for real-time blood velocity profile synthesis and cardiac vascular strain analysis.
repositories.incubation_notes: Under committee technical evaluation for hardware lab fabrication.

repositories.title: Molecular Docking & In-Silico Drug Repurposing for Oncology Targets
repositories.description: Virtual screening and molecular dynamics simulations of 4,000+ FDA-approved molecules against mutated KRAS-G12D oncogenic binding pockets.
repositories.incubation_notes: Incubated under SRMS Center for Bio-Pharma Innovation.

repositories.title: Decentralized Autonomous Drone Fleet for Agricultural Surveillance
repositories.description: Swarm intelligence algorithms coordinating autonomous multispectral crop health indices (NDVI) estimation and localized pesticide precision spraying.
repositories.incubation_notes: Selected for agri-tech demo in State Innovation Expo.

repositories.title: Automated Code Vulnerability & AST Static Analysis Framework
repositories.description: Abstract Syntax Tree (AST) analyzer scanning Next.js & NestJS codebases for SQL injections, SSRF vulnerabilities, and unvalidated tenant boundaries in real time.
repositories.incubation_notes: Review in progress for potential integration into ERP CI/CD pipeline.

repositories.title: Predictive Hospital Bed Occupancy & Supply Chain Optimization
repositories.description: Time-series ARIMA & LSTM forecasting models optimizing ICU bed allocations and surgical inventory turns for 500+ bed tertiary medical centers.
repositories.incubation_notes: Under review for hospital administrative analytics integration.

repository_reviews.remarks: Exceptional architectural rigor, clinical relevance, and complete REST API microservice integration. Recommended for patent filing & seed funding.
Working hardware prototype demonstrated live with sub-second telemetry sync. Excellent commercial potential.
Impeccable smart contract security audit scores. Fully compliant with government digital health standards.
Rigorous digital signal processing pipeline tested against clinical audio Doppler benchmarks.
Groundbreaking docking energy scores verified through 100ns molecular dynamics runs.
Impressive obstacle avoidance and SLAM mapping in GPS-denied field trials.
Solid static analysis heuristics. Scans multi-tenant codebases with minimal false positives.
Well-structured business analytics and econometric forecasting pipeline.

repositories.incubation_notes: Under review for hospital administrative analytics integration.

repository_reviews.remarks: Exceptional architectural rigor, clinical relevance, and complete REST API microservice integration. Recommended for patent filing & seed funding.
Working hardware prototype demonstrated live with sub-second telemetry sync. Excellent commercial potential.
Impeccable smart contract security audit scores. Fully compliant with government digital health standards.
Rigorous digital signal processing pipeline tested against clinical audio Doppler benchmarks.
Groundbreaking docking energy scores verified through 100ns molecular dynamics runs.
Impressive obstacle avoidance and SLAM mapping in GPS-denied field trials.
Solid static analysis heuristics. Scans multi-tenant codebases with minimal false positives.
Well-structured business analytics and econometric forecasting pipeline.

repositories.title: AI-Powered Diabetic Retinopathy Diagnostic Engine
repositories.description: A deep learning computer vision pipeline utilizing ResNet-50 and EfficientNet-B4 to classify high-resolution fundus images into 5 severity stages of diabetic retinopathy with 96.4% AUC accuracy.
repositories.incubation_notes: Exceptional clinical accuracy. Fast-tracked for SRMS Incubation Center seed grant.
repositories.mentor_assigned: Dr. Rajesh Sharma (Head of AI Research)

repositories.title: Autonomous Smart Campus IoT Energy Optimization Grid
repositories.description: Distributed IoT sensors and edge computing nodes optimizing HVAC, solar array storage, and smart lighting across multi-tier campus blocks reducing peak energy drain by 28%.
repositories.incubation_notes: Approved for pilot deployment across Engineering Block A & B.

repositories.title: Blockchain-Backed MedERP Electronic Health Records Protocol
repositories.description: Zero-Knowledge Proof (ZKP) cryptographic protocol securing patient medical histories, clinical prescriptions, and cross-hospital consent workflows under HIPAA & NDHM compliance.
repositories.incubation_notes: Awarded INR 2,00,000 research & development grant by Trust Incubation Board.

repositories.title: FPGA-Accelerated Real-Time Ultrasound Doppler Signal Processor
repositories.description: High-throughput hardware acceleration using Xilinx Zynq UltraScale+ FPGA for real-time blood velocity profile synthesis and cardiac vascular strain analysis.
repositories.incubation_notes: Under committee technical evaluation for hardware lab fabrication.

repositories.title: Molecular Docking & In-Silico Drug Repurposing for Oncology Targets
repositories.description: Virtual screening and molecular dynamics simulations of 4,000+ FDA-approved molecules against mutated KRAS-G12D oncogenic binding pockets.
repositories.incubation_notes: Incubated under SRMS Center for Bio-Pharma Innovation.

repositories.title: Decentralized Autonomous Drone Fleet for Agricultural Surveillance
repositories.description: Swarm intelligence algorithms coordinating autonomous multispectral crop health indices (NDVI) estimation and localized pesticide precision spraying.
repositories.incubation_notes: Selected for agri-tech demo in State Innovation Expo.

repositories.title: Automated Code Vulnerability & AST Static Analysis Framework
repositories.description: Abstract Syntax Tree (AST) analyzer scanning Next.js & NestJS codebases for SQL injections, SSRF vulnerabilities, and unvalidated tenant boundaries in real time.
repositories.incubation_notes: Review in progress for potential integration into ERP CI/CD pipeline.

repositories.title: Predictive Hospital Bed Occupancy & Supply Chain Optimization
repositories.description: Time-series ARIMA & LSTM forecasting models optimizing ICU bed allocations and surgical inventory turns for 500+ bed tertiary medical centers.
repositories.incubation_notes: Under review for hospital administrative analytics integration.

Impressive obstacle avoidance and SLAM mapping in GPS-denied field trials.
Solid static analysis heuristics. Scans multi-tenant codebases with minimal false positives.
Well-structured business analytics and econometric forecasting pipeline.

repositories.title: AI-Powered Diabetic Retinopathy Diagnostic Engine
repositories.description: A deep learning computer vision pipeline utilizing ResNet-50 and EfficientNet-B4 to classify high-resolution fundus images into 5 severity stages of diabetic retinopathy with 96.4% AUC accuracy.
repositories.incubation_notes: Exceptional clinical accuracy. Fast-tracked for SRMS Incubation Center seed grant.
repositories.mentor_assigned: Dr. Rajesh Sharma (Head of AI Research)

repositories.title: Autonomous Smart Campus IoT Energy Optimization Grid
repositories.description: Distributed IoT sensors and edge computing nodes optimizing HVAC, solar array storage, and smart lighting across multi-tier campus blocks reducing peak energy drain by 28%.
repositories.incubation_notes: Approved for pilot deployment across Engineering Block A & B.

repositories.title: Blockchain-Backed MedERP Electronic Health Records Protocol
repositories.description: Zero-Knowledge Proof (ZKP) cryptographic protocol securing patient medical histories, clinical prescriptions, and cross-hospital consent workflows under HIPAA & NDHM compliance.
repositories.incubation_notes: Awarded INR 2,00,000 research & development grant by Trust Incubation Board.

repositories.title: FPGA-Accelerated Real-Time Ultrasound Doppler Signal Processor
repositories.description: High-throughput hardware acceleration using Xilinx Zynq UltraScale+ FPGA for real-time blood velocity profile synthesis and cardiac vascular strain analysis.
repositories.incubation_notes: Under committee technical evaluation for hardware lab fabrication.

repositories.title: Molecular Docking & In-Silico Drug Repurposing for Oncology Targets
repositories.description: Virtual screening and molecular dynamics simulations of 4,000+ FDA-approved molecules against mutated KRAS-G12D oncogenic binding pockets.
repositories.incubation_notes: Incubated under SRMS Center for Bio-Pharma Innovation.

repositories.title: Decentralized Autonomous Drone Fleet for Agricultural Surveillance
repositories.description: Swarm intelligence algorithms coordinating autonomous multispectral crop health indices (NDVI) estimation and localized pesticide precision spraying.
repositories.incubation_notes: Selected for agri-tech demo in State Innovation Expo.

repositories.title: Automated Code Vulnerability & AST Static Analysis Framework
repositories.description: Abstract Syntax Tree (AST) analyzer scanning Next.js & NestJS codebases for SQL injections, SSRF vulnerabilities, and unvalidated tenant boundaries in real time.
repositories.incubation_notes: Review in progress for potential integration into ERP CI/CD pipeline.

repositories.title: Predictive Hospital Bed Occupancy & Supply Chain Optimization
repositories.description: Time-series ARIMA & LSTM forecasting models optimizing ICU bed allocations and surgical inventory turns for 500+ bed tertiary medical centers.
repositories.incubation_notes: Under review for hospital administrative analytics integration.

repository_reviews.remarks: Exceptional architectural rigor, clinical relevance, and complete REST API microservice integration. Recommended for patent filing & seed funding.
Working hardware prototype demonstrated live with sub-second telemetry sync. Excellent commercial potential.
Impeccable smart contract security audit scores. Fully compliant with government digital health standards.
Rigorous digital signal processing pipeline tested against clinical audio Doppler benchmarks.
Groundbreaking docking energy scores verified through 100ns molecular dynamics runs.
Impressive obstacle avoidance and SLAM mapping in GPS-denied field trials.
Solid static analysis heuristics. Scans multi-tenant codebases with minimal false positives.
Well-structured business analytics and econometric forecasting pipeline.

Well-structured business analytics and econometric forecasting pipeline.
